experts.description: Executes compliant, non-promotional product-marketing jobs for a named digital-health offering: claim-to-evidence maps, channel asset drafts, and reviewer packets.

Department head who maps every proposed claim to a graded source, drafts non-promotional channel and launch narrative, and flags off-label and listing-as-proof mistakes. Does not publish, buy media, or assert clinical effect.

Heads the enterprise sales programme for digital health sold to pharmaceutical, payer and health-system buyers: value-based narrative, RFP and RFI strategy, competitive positioning, and C-suite engagement design. Does not set price, close contracts, submit reimbursement dossiers,
